agent.finish_summary: Fixed regression in sqlparse/filters/reindent.py's _process_identifierlist: corrected an inverted condition that routed normal identifier lists into the VALUES-only wrapping branch (which lacked default one-per-line wrapping), causing SELECT column lists and similar identifier lists to stay on one line instead of reindenting one-per-line. Restored the branch to only apply VALUES-style wrapping when actually within sql.Values, and restored the default identifier-list branch's rule to break onto new lines per identifier when not compact and no wrap_after is set, or when wrap_after is exceeded. Verified with manual tests covering plain identifier lists, wrap_after, compact, comma_first, VALUES lists, and function call argument lists - all behave correctly.
